qe:
Error Spotting: Select the part that contains an error:
'The performance (A) / of our players (B) / was worst than (C) / I had expected (D).'
qh:
त्रुटि पहचानें: उस भाग का चयन करें जिसमें त्रुटि है:
'The performance (A) / of our players (B) / was worst than (C) / I had expected (D).'
e: Rule: For comparison between two states (expected vs actual), we use the comparative degree 'worse' instead of the superlative 'worst'.

qe: Direct/Indirect: The Captain said to the soldiers, 'Don't move from your posts.'
qh: अप्रत्यक्ष कथन: The Captain said to the soldiers, 'Don't move from your posts.'
o: The Captain ordered the soldiers not to move from their posts
The Captain told the soldiers that don't move
The Captain commanded the soldiers to not move
The Captain asked the soldiers no moving
e: Rule: Negative imperative sentences use 'ordered/commanded + not to + V1'. 'Your' changes to 'their' to match the object.

qe: Fill in the blank: 'The manager decided to ______ the meeting until next Monday.'
qh: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'The manager decided to ______ the meeting until next Monday.'
e: Phrasal Verb: 'Put off' means to postpone. 'Put out' means to extinguish.

qe: One Word Substitution: 'A person who is fluent in two languages.'
qh: एक शब्द: 'वह व्यक्ति जो दो भाषाओं में धाराप्रवाह हो।'
e: Vocabulary: Bilingual (द्विभाषी) is the term for someone who can speak two languages fluently.

qe: Sentence Improvement: 'Hardly had the sun rose when the birds started chirping.'
qh: वाक्य सुधार: 'Hardly had the sun rose when the birds started chirping.'
e: Rule: With 'had', the third form of the verb (V3) is used. The V3 of rise is risen (Rise-Rose-Risen).

qe: Synonym: Select the most appropriate synonym of: 'TACITURN'
qh: समानार्थी: 'TACITURN' का पर्यायवाची चुनें।
e: Meaning: Taciturn means reserved or uncommunicative in speech. Reticent is its closest synonym.

qe: Antonym: Select the most appropriate antonym of: 'ZENITH'
qh: विलोम: 'ZENITH' का विपरीतार्थक चुनें।
e: Meaning: Zenith means the highest point. Nadir (पाताल/न्यूनतम बिंदु) means the lowest point.

qe: Idiom: 'To hold one's tongue.'
qh: मुहावरे: 'To hold one's tongue.'
e: Meaning: To refrain from speaking or to stay silent.

qe: Active/Passive: 'Who painted this beautiful picture?'
qh: वाच्य परिवर्तन: 'Who painted this beautiful picture?'
o: By whom was this beautiful picture painted?
Who was this picture painted by?
By whom this picture was painted?
e: Rule: 'Who' changes to 'By whom' or 'Who...by'. Simple Past (V2) changes to 'was/were + V3'.

qe: Error Spotting: 'The cost (A) / of living (B) / is higher than (C) / the last year (D).'
qh: त्रुटि पहचानें: 'The cost (A) / of living (B) / is higher than (C) / the last year (D).'
e: Rule: Faulty comparison. We must compare the 'cost' of this year with the 'cost' of last year. Correct: 'higher than that of last year'.

qe: Spelling Test: Select the correctly spelled word.
qh: वर्तनी: सही शब्द चुनें।
e: Spelling: Hierarchy is the correct spelling.

qe: Fill in the blank: 'If you ______ the instructions, you wouldn't have made these mistakes.'
qh: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'If you ______ the instructions, you wouldn't have made these mistakes.'
e: Conditional: Type 3 Conditional follows the pattern: 'If + had + V3, would have + V3'.

qe: Idiom: 'To play second fiddle.'
qh: मुहावरे: 'To play second fiddle.'
o: To be in a subordinate position
e: Meaning: To take a less important or subordinate role compared to someone else.

qe: Error Spotting: 'Not only the students (A) / but also the teacher (B) / were happy (C) / with the results (D).'
qh: त्रुटि पहचानें: 'Not only the students (A) / but also the teacher (B) / were happy (C) / with the results (D).'
e: Rule: For 'Not only...but also', the verb agrees with the nearest subject. 'The teacher' is singular, so it should be 'was'.

qe: Active/Passive: 'A small boy was flying a colorful kite.'
qh: वाच्य परिवर्तन: 'A small boy was flying a colorful kite.'
o: A colorful kite was being flown by a small boy
e: Rule: Past Continuous changes to 'was/were + being + V3' (Fly-Flew-Flown).

qe: Antonym: Antonym of 'BENEVOLENT'.
qh: विलोम: 'BENEVOLENT' का विलोम।
e: Meaning: Benevolent means kind. Malevolent (द्रोही/बुरा चाहने वाला) means having a wish to do evil.

qe: One Word: 'A person who hates mankind.'
qh: एक शब्द: 'वह व्यक्ति जो मानव जाति से घृणा करता है।'
e: Vocabulary: Misanthrope (मानवद्वेषी) is the correct term. Philanthropist is the opposite.

qe: Sentence Improvement: 'The news was too good being true.'
qh: वाक्य सुधार: 'The news was too good being true.'
e: Rule: The structure is 'Too + Adjective + To + V1'.

qe: Direct/Indirect: He asked me, 'Where do you live?'
qh: अप्रत्यक्ष कथन: He asked me, 'Where do you live?'
o: He asked me where I lived
He asked me where did I live
He asked me where I live
He asked where was my home
e: Rule: In indirect questions, the sentence becomes assertive (Subject + Verb). Simple Present changes to Simple Past.

qe: Fill in the blank: 'You must dispense ______ his services.'
qh: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'You must dispense ______ his services.'
e: Phrasal Verb: 'Dispense with' means to stop using or get rid of something.

qe: Active/Passive: 'Shut all the doors.'
qh: वाच्य परिवर्तन: 'Shut all the doors.'
o: Let all the doors be shut
e: Rule: Imperative passive starts with 'Let + object + be + V3'.

qe: Synonym: Synonym of 'AFFLUENT'.
qh: समानार्थी: 'AFFLUENT' का पर्यायवाची।
e: Meaning: Affluent means having a great deal of money or wealthy.

qe: Error Spotting: 'He is senior (A) / than me (B) / in service (C) / No error (D).'
qh: त्रुटि पहचानें: 'He is senior (A) / than me (B) / in service (C) / No error (D).'
e: Rule: 'Senior' takes the preposition 'to', not 'than'.

qe: Idiom: 'To bite the dust.'
qh: मुहावरे: 'To bite the dust.'
e: Meaning: To fail or be defeated, often in a humiliating way.

qe: Vocabulary: Correct spelling of 'Maintanance'.
qh: वर्तनी: 'Maintanance' की सही वर्तनी चुनें।
e: Spelling: The correct spelling is Maintenance.

qe: Antonym: Antonym of 'ARTIFICIAL'.
qh: विलोम: 'ARTIFICIAL' का विलोम।
e: Meaning: The opposite of artificial (कृत्रिम) is Natural (प्राकृतिक).

qe: Fill in the blank: 'I prefer tea ______ coffee.'
qh: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'I prefer tea ______ coffee.'
e: Rule: The verb 'prefer' takes 'to' for comparison between two nouns.

qe: One Word Substitution: 'A collection of poems.'
qh: एक शब्द: 'कविताओं का संग्रह।'
e: Vocabulary: Anthology is the specific word for a collection of literary works.

qe: Sentence Improvement: 'If I am you, I wouldn't forgive him.'
qh: वाक्य सुधार: 'If I am you, I wouldn't forgive him.'
e: Rule: For hypothetical/imaginary situations, 'were' is used with all subjects.

qe: Error Spotting: 'The jury (A) / were (B) / unanimous (C) / in its decision (D).'
qh: त्रुटि पहचानें: 'The jury (A) / were (B) / unanimous (C) / in its decision (D).'
e: Rule: When a collective noun acts as a single unit (unanimous), it takes a singular verb ('was').

qe: Direct/Indirect: My mother said, 'Honesty is the best policy.'
qh: अप्रत्यक्ष कथन: My mother said, 'Honesty is the best policy.'
o: My mother said that honesty is the best policy
My mother said that honesty was the best policy
My mother told honesty is the best policy
e: Rule: Tense does not change for Proverbs/Universal Truths.

qe: Fill in the blank: 'He died ______ cholera.'
qh: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'He died ______ cholera.'
e: Rule: 'Die of' is used for diseases.

qe: Idiom: 'To let the cat out of the bag.'
qh: मुहावरे: 'To let the cat out of the bag.'
e: Meaning: To reveal a secret, usually by mistake.

qe: Active/Passive: 'They are laughing at the poor man.'
qh: वाच्य परिवर्तन: 'They are laughing at the poor man.'
o: The poor man is being laughed at by them
e: Rule: Present Continuous passive: 'is/am/are + being + V3'. Don't forget the preposition 'at'.

qe: Synonym: Synonym of 'CANDID'.
qh: समानार्थी: 'CANDID' का पर्यायवाची।
e: Meaning: Candid means honest and straightforward, or Frank.
